description: This file defines the CustomJobParameterResolver class used for resolving custom job parameters within the Spring Batch processing framework. It interacts with the CustomJobParameterRepository to retrieve parameter data, parses JSON content into JobParameterDTO objects, and provides methods for resolving parameters into the batch step context.

classes.name: CustomJobParameterResolver
classes.description: A component class responsible for resolving custom job parameters within Spring Batch jobs, including fetching parameters from repository and injecting them into execution context.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a specific custom job parameter and adds its value into the step execution context under a specified key.

methods.name: getCustomJobParameterSet
methods.description: Fetches the set of JobParameterDTOs for a given step execution from the custom job parameter repository.

methods.name: getCustomJobParameterById
methods.description: Retrieves the parameter value associated with a specific parameter name from the stored custom parameters.

methods.name: getJobParameters
methods.description: Converts the parameters from the StepExecution's JobParameters into a Map for easier access.
